items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛排位赛：拉塞尔夺杆位
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在巴库举行的阿塞拜疆大奖赛F1排位赛中以超过0.8秒的优势夺得杆位。积分榜领先者基米·安东内利在Q1撞上1号弯内侧护墙，损坏悬挂，无法继续参加排位赛。
items.summaryEn: George Russell took pole position by over eight tenths of a second in Azerbaijan Grand Prix Formula 1 qualifying in Baku. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli hit the inside wall at Turn 1 in Q1 and broke his suspension, so he could take no further part in qualifying.
detailZh: 阿尔派复兴背后的意外前F1车手助力
阿尔派透露，前红牛车手、领奖台获得者丹尼尔·科维亚特是支持其本赛季F1复兴的意外资产。
detailEn: The surprise ex-F1 driver aiding Alpine's revival
Alpine has revealed a surprise asset supporting its F1 revival this season - ex-Red Bull driver and podium finisher Daniil Kvyat
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔落后0.837秒位列第二，皮亚斯特里落后0.838秒排名第三。
安东内利虽凭早前圈速名义上进入Q2，但因悬挂损坏未做出时间。
阿尔派透露前红牛车手、领奖台获得者丹尼尔·科维亚特是支持其本赛季F1复兴的意外资产。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc was second, 0.837s behind, with Piastri third, 0.838s back.
Antonelli nominally made Q2 thanks to an earlier laptime but set no time due to his broken suspension.
Alpine has revealed ex-Red Bull driver and podium finisher Daniil Kvyat as a surprise asset supporting its F1 revival this season.
